steps: The Plant army, empowered by Mina, stalls your lab assault. Firenze attempts a surprise attack, only to discover that Darcia had altered her body. As you dive into the tank, Darcia transforms into the "Lithe Beauty"...
02:45, Messis Month 8th, Greenhouse District, Philae, Lab Core
Your strategy was flawless. Our armies crushed three of HQ's legions.==W== The enemy is crumbled, scattering toward nearby cities in disarray.
As ordered, the Intelligent Plants used non-lethal force.==W== We simply neutralized the officers and seized their weapons and supplies.
It's finally over. Fighting all day really takes it out of you... Great work, everyone.==W== How's the city?
The citizens are sheltering safely at home. As requested, the Intelligent Plants are standing guard and distributing necessities.
However...==W== We're short on Gen-3 units. I had to redeploy this facility's guards to the city. Please forgive the security gap here.
It's fine. I've got you two to keep me safe, don't I?
By the way, where is Mina?
Your Majesty, she was exhausted from working all evening, so I sent her to bed.==W== She's resting in a secure location, don't worry.
Explosions? Firenze, what's happening out there?
Unclear. The Plants say...==W== Intruders breached the greenhouses. They're attacking the underground lab's gate.
What can I hold you with? I offer you fresh leaves, stalled crossbow bolts, and shards of razor-sharp stone.
I offer you slumber granted by the wild spirits.
If Boss is held captive and cannot come to me...==W== Then I shall go to ==SEX4==.
Master...==W== Master is amazing! We actually brought Grace out of the Monolith!
Ventus magic coats my blade, blasting everywhere.==W== With this power, those Intelligent Plants don't stand a chance.
Noya and Nazuka made it...==W== With them, Firenze, and my new authority, we have a real shot at taking down Darcia.
Your Majesty. I'm impressed your ex-subordinates infiltrated this deep. They are far more competent than those useless United Harvest grunts.
Though, eventually...==W== They're just moths flying to a flame.
Human sleep cycles are woefully inefficient.==W== So, Mina and I signed a contract.==W== Now she enjoys eternal rest in the tank, providing us a constant stream of spirit and memory data.
The Gen-3 Intelligent Plants—powered only by Nyx—had raw power, but lacked coordination.
Now that I've added a trace of Mina to the mix, their teamwork is flawless.
They're twisting their vines together ... into spears?
And that tight formation!==W== Tsk...==W== This is gonna be a headache.
Whoa, hey!==W== Since when did these weeds learn how to work as a team?
Your Majesty, see that? Once we patched the flaws, our Intelligent Plants became invincible.
I know you're sentimental.==W== Let me preserve your ex-subordinates in tanks, too.
You can visit them daily.==W== After all,==W== nothing beats the loyalty of a specimen in a tank.
... Firenze? Hah. What is the meaning of this? I believe your rapier has found the wrong target.
No. I have been waiting for this exact moment, and this rapier was sharpened specifically for you.
... So, you are determined to stand in my way. How disappointing.
I thought a woman betrayed by her closest ally would do anything to reshape this filthy world.
I don't get it, Firenze. She stabbed you in the back. Why do you still care?
Heh... Heheh. Fine. Since she's so important to you, how about I put you in charge of her tank?
Hahahaha! Just kidding. I wouldn't be that cruel. Tell you what—I'll put you in the tank with her. That way you can be together forever ... serving me until you rot.
Hmph. I expected a real argument. Yet it's all meaningless drivel.
Drivel? Ouch. I was offering you a gift. I'll admit, that Nazuka and Petal Bloom are quite capable. My Gen-3 Intelligent Plants are actually struggling.
But if I toss a premium nutrient like you into the mix? We'd see a 4th generation evolve. That will put the reins back in my hands.
And you think I'll just play along?
Obedience would be nice, but I know you. Pity. Looks like Nyx will have to work overtime.
Since you won't volunteer as the nutrient, I'd have to crank up the ... extraction rate on what I have.
Ah, but of course, it comes with a risk. Drain it too fast ... and Nyx's soul burns out in a flash.
And she'll suffer every second of it because you said no.
Careful. Lose your cool, and you lose your life.
Ah! ==SEX12== Tyrant! Why throw yourself in danger?! I cannot allow harm to come to you... Please, I beg you, stand back!
==SEX12== Tyrant... Are you shielding this traitor?
This wasn't in the plan... Hm? I said I could be your pawn, but I never said you could step onto the board yourself.
I'm not the kind of player who watches from the sidelines.
And I don't treat my partners as expendable pawns!
Ah... I see... So that's it... I understand now, ==SEX12== Tyrant. That wretch has poisoned your mind...
Fear not, my Tyrant. I will purge this filth for you at once! Once I grind her into nutrients, everything will be—
Heh. Don't take it personally. I just don't have time to listen to your preaching.
And another thing. Stop comparing me to yourself.
I never thought of this world as "filthy." You want to reshape reality, but your hatred doesn't come from some grand betrayal...
It stems from the fact that no one has ever loved you. Tell me, has anyone ever truly loved you?
Hah... Of course! The Tyrant loves me! My Tyrant loves me more than anyone else alive!
I am ==SEX3== most devoted servant! No one understands ==SEX4== like I do... I adore ==SEX4==, so naturally, ==SEX== loves me in return!
Ah... ==SEX12== Tyrant! Allow me to prove it to you right now—
Hahaha! I told you, didn't I? Your rapier has found the wrong target. You cannot kill me, Firenze.
This body is one with the plant now. It has no fear of your blade!
You could never comprehend my devotion to ==SEX12== Tyrant! Your betrayal, you deluding the Tyrant... It is all nothing but a trial the Tyrant has bestowed upon me!
And once I overcome this trial, my love—and my loyalty—will be proven absolute!
What did you just take from me?
I never thought you'd go so far as to modify your own body into a plant. That's also why your senses have dulled.
The rest is up to you—Boss!
Firenze flings a green key she swiped from Darcia's cloak high into the air. It lands in my palm.
Your Majesty, what are you doing?
Hmph. Taking your eyes off me? You must have confidence to spare.
Insolent brat! Plants, attack!==W== Kill Firenze!==W== She isn't even fit to be your nutrient!
Outside, the Intelligent Plants suddenly cease combat. Disregarding damage, they try to retreat to Darcia's side.
Plants, stand down.==W== By order of the Tyrant.
Darcia...==W== Did you forget that Mina was obsessed with the rules?
In your system, the Tyrant's word is law. Heh...==W== To plants that assimilated Mina's mind, your words mean nothing next to the Tyrant's command.
Huff... Huff... Finally made it up here.
I scale the iron ladder to the top of the tank and turn the emerald key to unlock the heavy lid.
Psychic Fluid...==W== The Bishop must be right at the bottom of this tank.
Help me... It burns... Make it stop... Anyone... Hate... Love... Gone... I can't see...
Ugh—==W==I'm supposed to be immune to magic. How are these voices forcing their way into my head?==W== What is this stuff?
Your Majesty! What are you doing?! Get down from there!
You have no protection!==W== That Psychic Fluid will dissolve your memories instantly!
My immunity==W== might not be enough==W== to save me this time.
Losing my memories...==W== I'd just end up right back where I started—==W==waking up lost in that desert...
Heh.==W== That doesn't sound so scary.
Even if I lose everything,==W== even if I'm all alone,==W== my friends will find me. They'll bring me back.
Whether I'm the company's Boss,==W== the legendary Tyrant,==W== or just some passing Trekker...
This==W== is the path==W== I choose.
Y-Your Majesty...==W== What have you done?
How dare you...==W== Firenze! If ==SEX=='s harmed in any way, you'll pay for it with your life!
Darcia's magic streaks past Firenze, slamming into the tank holding the Lithe Grass Mother.
The thick glass shatters. The massive creature surges out, coiling around Darcia and fusing with her body.
Firenze!==W== With this perfect form—united with the Lithe Grass—==W==I'll send you to your grave!
